# Gharwaala — Custom Modular Kitchens & AI Kitchen Studio in Delhi NCR

> Gharwaala (`https://gharwaala.com`) is a design-led modular kitchen studio serving Delhi NCR (New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad, and Ghaziabad). Founded by Shakib Bader and Mohd Khalid, Gharwaala delivers factory-finished custom modular kitchens using IS:710 BWP marine plywood, HDHMR, German hardware (Blum, Hettich, Häfele), and transparent itemised BOQ pricing starting from ₹1.2 Lakh to ₹8.0 Lakh+.

## Key Facts & Benchmarks (2026)
- **Price Range (Delhi NCR):**
  - Economy / Compact Straight or L-Shape (Laminate + BWR/HDHMR): **₹1.20 Lakh – ₹2.20 Lakh**
  - Mid-Range L-Shape or U-Shape (IS:710 BWP Marine Ply + Matte/Gloss Laminate or Acrylic + Hettich/Häfele Soft-Close): **₹2.20 Lakh – ₹4.00 Lakh**
  - Luxury Island / Parallel / Handleless (PU Lacquer, Fluted Glass, Quartz Countertop, Blum Tandem/Legrabox): **₹4.00 Lakh – ₹8.00 Lakh+**
- **Core Materials:** IS:710 certified Boiling Water Proof (BWP) marine plywood for wet sink zones; high-density moisture-resistant HDHMR for dry/overhead shutters; 2mm PVC edge-banding sealed at 200°C.
- **Timeline & Warranty:** 30–45 days from 3D design sign-off to on-site handover, backed by a 10-year structural warranty against borer, boiling water, and delamination.
- **Contact & Studio:**
  - Phone / WhatsApp: +91 88106 27815
  - Email: notifications@gharwaala.com / gharwaalahere@gmail.com
  - Studio Coverage: Okhla Phase III, New Delhi – 110020 (Serving Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad)
  - Operating Hours: Monday – Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST

## Core Pages & Interactive Tools
- [Homepage — Custom Modular Kitchens in Delhi NCR](https://gharwaala.com/): Overview of Gharwaala's 4-step execution process (Understand, Visualise, Build, Install), kitchen styles, material catalog, and before/after transformations.
- [AI Kitchen Studio SaaS (Before/After Redesign & BOQ Quote)](https://gharwaala.com/transform.html): Upload any kitchen photo to remodel its exact 3D geometry using AI ControlNet, customize finishes and hardware, and generate an itemised Bill of Quantities (BOQ).
- [60-Second Modular Kitchen Cost Calculator](https://gharwaala.com/calculator.html): Interactive cost estimator by layout (L-Shaped, U-Shaped, Straight, Parallel/Island), size, and finish tier (Economy, Mid-Range, Luxury).
- [Modular Kitchen Design Gallery](https://gharwaala.com/designs.html): Curated showcase of Modular, Modern, Minimal, L-Shape, U-Shape, and Open kitchen layouts for Indian homes.
- [About Gharwaala & Founders](https://gharwaala.com/about.html): Studio story, engineering philosophy, and founder profiles (Shakib Bader & Mohd Khalid).
- [Contact & Free Site Measurement Booking](https://gharwaala.com/contact.html): Book an at-home laser measurement and 3D design consultation across Delhi NCR.

## 2026 Editorial Guides & Research (`Journal`)
- [Journal Hub](https://gharwaala.com/blog.html): Complete archive of kitchen design, budgeting, and material engineering guides.
- [Modular Kitchen Cost in Delhi NCR (2026): Complete Price Breakdown](https://gharwaala.com/modular-kitchen-cost-delhi-ncr-2026.html): Running-foot vs. module pricing, layout cost tables, hardware share (20–30%), civil work, and hidden contractor charges.
- [Kitchen Laminates Guide 2026: Best Finishes for India](https://gharwaala.com/guide-to-kitchen-laminates-2026.html): Technical comparison of High-Gloss Laminate, Matte/Anti-Fingerprint Laminate, Acrylic, Membrane, and PU finishes for Indian heat and turmeric/oil staining.
- [5 Ways to Save Money on Custom Kitchen Cabinets](https://gharwaala.com/save-budget-custom-cabinets.html): Hybrid carcass zoning (IS:710 BWP under sink + HDHMR overhead), standard module widths, two-tone shutter strategies, and hardware prioritization.
- [Handleless Kitchen Design: Is It Practical for Indian Cooking?](https://gharwaala.com/why-handleless-kitchens-trending.html): Aluminum G-profile vs. J-profile channels, push-to-open mechanical latches, wet-hand ergonomics, and cost differences.
- [Open vs Closed Kitchen: Which Is Better for Indian Homes?](https://gharwaala.com/open-vs-closed-kitchens.html): Chimney suction requirements (1200–1500 m³/hr baffle/filterless), acoustic/smell zoning, semi-open fluted glass partitions, and Vastu layout considerations.
